import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Dataset with features on different scales
data = {
    'age': [25, 35, 45, 55, 65],
    'salary': [30000, 50000, 70000, 90000, 110000],
    'experience': [2, 8, 15, 22, 30]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Implement min-max scaling formula: (x - min) / (max - min)
df_scaled = (df - df.min()) / (df.max() - df.min())

# Verify scaled values are between 0 and 1
print("Min values:", df_scaled.min().values)
print("Max values:", df_scaled.max().values)

# Print original and scaled dataframes side by side
print("\nOriginal Data:")
print(df)
print("\nScaled Data [0, 1]:")
print(df_scaled)
